name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

eligibility.other_conditions: Must own a residential house with suitable rooftop space and an active domestic electricity connection.

benefits: Direct Central Financial Assistance (CFA) subsidy of up to Rs. 78,000 for installing rooftop solar systems, providing up to 300 units of free green electricity every month.
documents_required: Bank Account Details (linked to Aadhaar for DBT)
application_process: Register on National Portal for Rooftop Solar (pmsuryaghar.gov.in) with electricity consumer number.
Apply for rooftop solar plant and choose a registered DISCOM vendor.
Commission system, complete net-metering inspection, and receive DBT subsidy in bank account.
statutory_citation: MNRE Notification No. 318/17/2024-GCRT (National Solar Mission Directive)
